body:
Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#190

## Summary
- Capture a centered square visualization thumbnail when saving presets and pipelines.
- Store thumbnails on saved preset/pipeline records and render saved names over the image background with contrast overlays.
- Render legacy saved presets and pipelines without stored thumbnails with a generated visualization-like background so old saves no longer keep the old plain-button appearance.
- Add issue research, latest PR/issue data, and verification artifacts under `docs/case-studies/issue-190`.

## Follow-up Analysis
- Owner feedback on 2026-06-26 reported that saves were broken and old saves looked unchanged.
- The unchanged old-save appearance was reproduced from the data model: pre-existing records have no `thumbnail`, and the first implementation preserved their old plain rendering.
- The follow-up fix keeps the saved data shape compatible and changes the renderer fallback, not the stored legacy records.

## Visual Verification
![Saved preset and pipeline thumbnail buttons](https://github.com/konard/Jhon-Crow-audio-recorder-with-visualization/blob/issue-190-b1a768dfa055/docs/case-studies/issue-190/saved-item-thumbnails.png?raw=true)

## Tests
- `npm run typecheck` passed.
- `npm run build` passed.
- `npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/preset-management.cy.js,cypress/e2e/pipeline-mode.cy.js` with a root static server: 36 passing, 4 failing.
  - `preset-management.cy.js`: 12 passing, including the new legacy preset fallback test.
  - `pipeline-mode.cy.js`: 24 passing, including the legacy saved pipeline fallback test.
  - Remaining pipeline failures are the existing broad pipeline scenarios logged in `docs/case-studies/issue-190/logs/cypress-focused-after-fix-root-server.log`; the saved-pipeline fallback assertion passed.

## Notes
- Thumbnail capture uses native Canvas 2D `drawImage()` to crop the current visualization to a 96px square data URL.
- Saved data without `thumbnail` now renders with a generated fallback background and readable label overlay instead of the old plain style.
title: Add saved visualization thumbnails
